correctness.rationale: The morphism recurrence gives p_j=nu_2(j+1) mod 2. With P the least power of 2 at least ell, each of two ell-windows contains at most one position j with P|(j+1); other symbols are fixed by the starting residue and d mod P. Each hole bit is k+nu_2(quotient) mod 2. If both windows have holes, their quotients differ by positive Delta=(d+b-a)/P, and the exact parity-pair lemma gives E_Delta={(0,0),(0,1),(1,0)} for odd Delta and all four pairs for even Delta. Explicit congruence constructions show each allowed pattern occurs infinitely often. On shifting d by 2P, ordinary bits and holes persist and Delta rises by 2, preserving its parity. This gives equality of exact boundary sets for every r and therefore every d, ell. Each r contributes at most four pairs. The submitted standalone checker verifies the morphic valuation identity, parity lemma, symbolic period and direct prefix sets.

value.rationale: The extended boundary sequence was introduced to capture paired endpoints of all long factors and has applications to local testability and boundary-based complexity. General 2-automaticity leaves wide room for aperiodic behavior, as stressed by the source Sturmian examples. Here an aperiodic canonical automatic word has a *purely periodic boundary sequence at every window width*, with an explicit valid period O(ell), a finite exact construction, and at most O(ell) endpoint pairs. This closes a natural uniform structural question for a foundational automatic sequence, rather than an arbitrary finite-slice enumeration.
